Nordic Lifting Wall Ball for Crossfit & Fitness - Medicine Ball for Gym and Strength Training In my photo, I show a side-by-side comparison of a medicine ball (the Nordic Fitness ball on the left) & a slam ball (the smaller ball on the right). These are similar animals, but still very different.

Yes, they're both round & heavy. However, a medicine ball is usually (as in the case of this Nordic Fitness model) much larger & will have a slight bounce to it.

The slam ball is usually small & very dense. And normally will not bounce much (unless it's over inflated).

So while both can be used for similar exercises, if you really want to round out your routines, it's best to have both.

This medicine ball from Nordic Fitness is very well made & comes with a basic exercise guide & welcome letter.
text_fidelity_b: Nordic Lifting Wall Ball for Crossfit & Fitness - Medicine Ball for Gym and Strength Training

Wipkal 2 Pcs New Cooling Hat Ice Hat Wide Brim Cap, Summer Sun Hat Sunscreen Cooling Air Conditioning Cap Ice Cap Towel UV Protection for Women Men Light Gray Thought this will beat the traditional hay hats, wrong!
Hat is way too large in diameter. You will catch yourself bumping into everything. Sort of like wearing two numbers larger shoes, try it! it's annoying and so is the round hat, I guarantee you.
Next non-sense with the round hat is the side slits behind the mesh let the sun in. Rating sun protection 1 star as it defies the purpose of why I ended up buying this in first place; and If I posted picturet after first couple hours of wearing it outside in decent yet not extreme heat, you'd be horrified to notice the staining from sweat after it dries, in repeated sessions. It looks disgusting. Fabric, or faux leather, whatever the outer coating is made of, does not give an indication of long lasting life of a product, instead I expect it to peel soon, matter of fact, mesh on one side is already ripping off a good section at the lower seam due to not so precise stitching that skipped the mesh thanks to its large openings. The central insulation material that seem to be the same glossy flex aluminum you see inside the small refrigeration lunch bags is incredibly thin and expected to rip after a year or two of use - IF nothing else rips before it of course. (mesh pun intended)
Finally the inner blue "cooling" fabric that is to be wetted... impressions after handling it is nothing like what one thinks of when ordering this set. Thought it'll be pretty thick to absorb enough liquid to provide lasting cooling effect. What you will get? Another thin layer, to me these words immediately jumped into my mind: "A blue toilet paper, or is it actual fabric?" Yep, those are the impressions and the rating solely for the round hat so far.
I have yet to try the baseball type hat, but I dont see it to be any better except I wont be bumping my head against the firm hat that loves to bump into everything around you. On the other hand, sun protection is limited with baseball type hat as it doesnt cover in entire circle but a small section. Like I said in the headline, I dont know.
To me it seems that its rather a gimmick, poorly executed at that.
Not that it couldnt be a good product, if it was manufactured with PRO skilled team that would research, test and fix issues that I'm finding out on my own stupidity for wasting money on it even!
Only 5 stars are for the light weight but guess if I still wear it? After about a week? 10 hours of use I'm back to good old school hay hat I got good few years back and cant be happier!
Hope this reading helps you decide, better stuff your old hay hat with wet toilet paper and you'll be better with it than with this nonsensical pile of garbage that should never been manufactured as all it may do is pollute Earth with more artificial toxic materials causing all sorts of skin issues on humans, animals and foliage.

text_fidelity_a:
Eureka! Solitaire AL 1 Person, 3 Season, Camping and Backpacking Tent This Eureka Solitaire should be considered more as a bivy than a tent. I suppose it is more a bivy/tent hybrid. Being an inbetween, it is not super light, but is not super heavy either. Weight on this is 3 lbs, 2 oz. That is with poles, stakes, guy lines, and carry bag. So the tent is not an ultralight, especially for the size of this thing.
Pros:
1. Packs down small and does not take up much room in a backpack.
2. Fairly light
3. Fly can be rolled up to allow for maximum airflow when the weather permits.
Cons:
1. Not free standing. Must be staked down.
2. Fly is not removable.
3. No vestibule.
4. Must crawl in/out from the front. Can be hard to keep from getting wet/dirty if there was a storm/rain the night before.

Overall, if you are looking for a bivy style tent, this probably is what you want. Unless you want an ultra-light, which this is not.
I personally would not recommend this style of tent. But, if you are looking for a nicely built bivy tent, this is probably it, if you do not mind the weight.
Would be really good for motorcycle or bike camping. Not really for backpacking, as the weight is comparable to a good 2 person tent!
If I were going to carry a 3lb+ tent, I would get one with enough room to sit up in and that has a vestibule. Plenty of those tents out there in the 3lb range.
text_fidelity_b: Eureka! Solitaire AL 1 Person, 3 Season, Camping and Backpacking Tent

CRKT Sting Fixed Blade Knife with Sheath: Everyday Carry Boot Knife, Double Edged Powder Coated Stainless Steel, Contoured Handle, Nylon Sheath with Strapping for Carry Options 2020 I was a little apprehensive about buying this knife in the first place. I didn't really NEED it, but it sure looked like a good idea and a good addition to my hiking/backpacking/fly fishing arsenal. First, let me say I was impressed with the quality. As a full piece of steel with a full tang, it is unlikely to separate at any time. While the handle is small owing to the size of the blade, it is still manageable. The handle has a nice big eyelet to which a safely line could be tied or, should one be in the mood, to use as a starter to tie to a branch to make a spear.

The sheath is also much better than I had expected. I had originally thought the sheath was just going to be straight nylon. This is not the case. There is a hard plastic liner within that secures the knife blade and keeps the blade from cutting up the sheath. Also, what looks like a thumb spot from the handle doubles as a non-mechanical locking mechanism within the sheath. It requires a decent tug to pull the knife out. This would certainly curtail accidental fallouts while walking or sprinting.

The nylon strap is both strong and adjustable. Overall, I'm quite impressed with this little gem.

The technical information on this fabric is the following: 600D waterproof, anti-UV, polyurethane (PU) coated Oxford fabric. This is a heavyweight, 100% polyester fabric that is exceptionally durable and hard-wearing. This fabric is typically used for all sorts of outdoor products, such as tents, backpacks, camping cots, lawn furniture, boat cushions, and baby strollers. In spite of being plastic, the manufacturer claims it is “breathable,” which supposedly means it won’t make your skin sweat as heavily as other types of plastic.

(Note: If you are in a public place, especially a crowded entertainment event in a public park after dark, it is absolutely not a good idea to put anything valuable, such as a smartphone or a wallet, in that pouch if you don’t want to be an easy target for a clever pickpocket.)

5. No assembly is required.

CONS

1. I could not figure out how to fold up this chair, because it does not work like the chairs of this type I have owned in the past, and it does not come with any instructions. The main display panel is low enough and the seat is high enough to accommodate TV viewing. Most of the bike has been pre-assembled so it only takes a short time to finish the assembly.

Fat Burn

Max Fat Burn

Aerobic

Hill

Interval

Mountain

The pedals are comfortable to push and the position you are sitting in seems ideal if you are worried about your knees being uncomfortable. Some bikes I've tried are too uncomfortable to use, so this one was a nice surprise.

The way this bike is made makes it easy to move. There are "wheels" or at least leveling caps that make the bike easier to move if you have to slide this back and forth on the carpet. Everything is included for assembly and once you get this bike all put together, it is very easy to use and quite convenient. Since it is so quiet, you can even use this bike in the middle of the night or while other people are sleeping.

In 32 minutes it seems possible to burn 250 calories, ride

4.6 miles and maintain a speed at about 8.2 or higher on level 2. There are many levels, you can work your way up to various levels or change the levels manually for cooldown.

One day I rode for 8 miles in an hour!

~The Rebecca Review

First impression is good idea but poor quality. I like the idea of having a portable collapsible flask for theme parks, hiking and traveling on plane (after security checkout).
One design flaw is that the cap is not attached to the flask so you can lose the cap easily since it's so small.
The biggest flaw with this brand compared to the E-Senior brand I tried is that the insides were stuck together like glue. I didn't think silicon could be this sticky (unless there is another chemical making it stick). Now I'm afraid to drink out of it.
It wasn't suction pressure but literally sticking like glue (see video). Could barely even pry insides open. Used a plastic chopstick carefully to help prevent puncturing.
The flask does stand up but the shape is all dented and deformed from being stuck together like the first one.

Also, as with many flasks of this type, it seems like a hit or miss regarding the taste of water when drinking from it. I'm returning this one anyways.
But I was planning to soak insides with lemon and baking soda water overnight and give it a thorough soap wash. But it's off to a bad start. I'll see if a replacement is any better.

*update* Received a replacement. It was still sticky again on the insides and had to get a long chopstick to separate the insides.
I'm returning this one too. I didn't like the idea that the material was sticky inside and I'm gonna be drinking out of it too. Just bad quality.

I tried another brand, E-Senior (probably from same manufacturer as it looks exactly the same), but this brand seems to have better quality for some reason. It even looks like the product pic when standing with a nice rounded rectangular shape. The insides opened up just fine without any stickiness at all. Mabe this company has better quality control.

text_fidelity_a:
Franklin Sports NCAA Team Licensed College Football Backpack - Official Logos and Colors - Heather Gray - 18" x 12" x 4" When I saw this Gator backpack by Franklin I was excited to get it - but now that I’ve used it I am left underwhelmed.

The logo is EXCELLENT. The modern Albert head logo embroidered on a royal blue field circled in orange - affixed permanently to the heather grey shell outer fabric of the backpack does look great.

Unfortunately that is about the extent of what I like about this backpack.

The outer shell material is excessively stiff and the inner liner shell feels like cheap polyvinyl material that crinkles loudly anytime you move it.

The overall design makes poor use of space and offers almost no built in organization methods, unlike most backpacks.

The outer pocket, where typical backpacks have an area to hold things you need to access easily - writing utensils, keys, wallet, etc - this one opens to a large pocket that encompasses the entire front with only a small mesh divider that rises to the level of the zipper. If you attempt to keep something there the first time the backpack is carried in any way but vertical everything in this pouch mixes within the larger front pocket.

Each side has mesh places to hold water bottles or possibly an umbrella. Unfortunately these are made so small that while you can force a typical water bottle into it - it’s not easy.

The main compartment has 1 divided area that is created with the crinkly material and elastic. It will hold a small laptop but the depth of this bag is so minimal that if that was in it there would be little room for anything else.

While the ergonomically shaped straps have padding and meshed fabric for ventilation the back does not.

The bottom of the bag has 2 zippers that open and reveal the ball hammock that extends from one pocket then buckle clips within the other with 2 plastic buckles. I managed to use this to hold a beach towel once but for the most part I’ve found that feature a waste.

At this price point there are vastly superior backpack options. In regards to functionality, overall design and materials used this backpack is poor and I would not recommend it.

I would advise finding another Gator backpack or attaching an embroidered Gator logo to a quality backpack.
text_fidelity_b: Franklin Sports NCAA Team Licensed College Football Backpack - Official Logos and Colors - Heather Gray - 18" x 12" x 4"

Etekcity Water Filter Straw Camping Water Purification Portable Water Filter Survival Kit for Camping, Hiking, Hurricanes I've had this on my bug-out list for a while now. At last I got it. I had questions I had doubts, because I was at first thinking of this as a filtration system. Yes it filtrates water.... no it is not a general filtration system. It is a "Personal" filter. A sip straw with advantages. Emphasis on the 'sip'. If you got as far as the comments section, you've seen what they say about it. This is for hiking, rather than camping use. Something to get water from point A to your mouth. However.... I did want to find out if I could use the bag to filter water into a cup for heating and it DOES work! You fill the bag with water... as clear as you can find, screw it into the straw, and gently but firmly squeeze. Filtered water will slowly dribble out of the sipping end. Not fast, but if you need a cup of coffee or some soup, it would be worth it. We are not talking kitchen magic here folks, we are talking survival.
To make this last as long as possible, use the clearest water you can find, use the little blue add-on filter, and backwash every time you use it. Just remember, water from a street gutter is not a good source, because of all the chemical contaminates that might be in it. This is for dirt, microbes, and insect contamination, not oil, anti-freeze and cleaners!
Picture 1 shows the bag screwed into the base, 2 shows the long folded tube attached to the base. you can also take off the short tube from the blue filter and attach it to the end of the long tube. Picture 3 shows the blue filter and the disk replacement filters for it (you get 6 total), and 4 shows the back-flow set-up. The plunger tube snugs 'into' not 'over' the mouth piece and the small blue filter's tube as well.

This was one of the Eteckcity products that I could get free or at reduced price in exchange for a review. I won't 'guess' if it works I won't say something I don't believe. This my honest opinion of a product I acquired to use personally.
text_fidelity_b: Etekcity Water Filter Straw Camping Water Purification Portable Water Filter Survival Kit for Camping, Hiking, Hurricanes

Jeff & Aimy Women's Lightweight Cotton Bucket Beach Sun Hats Ponytail Hole Wide Brim UV Protection Foldable Travel Fishing Sunhats Gray I am reviewing the Jeff & Aimmy Cotton Vucket Hat in the color " Black#990022", which is gray with a black bow. I was supposed to receive the hat in black ( 00707_black), so that it was may come up under my review. I will include pics of the hat on.

Before you select one, make sure to take a look at the sizing. There are TWO sizes available, Medium OR Large. There is no elastic, nor ability to adjust, so choose wisely.

Medium fits 55-58CM (22.2"-22.8");
Large fits 58-61CM (23.03"- 24.0") ----my head measures 23.75", this fits very well.

Despite that the product description states that the hat is adjustable, it is NOT. The only portion that is "adjustable" is the optional chin strap. On mine, it can be kept clipped on, or taken off. There is a toggle to make it tighter against the face, or allow it to be loose.

The interior has what appears to be an elastic band, but it is not elastic. It's purpose is more like that of a sweat band or to provide some grip, but it doesn't not stretch. This will either fit, or it won't.

I normally like Jeff & Aimmy products, and overall I like this too. I just want to see a cleaned up, more accurate description. (and what are with all the reviews for this product yet are for something not being sold here?)

The material is soft, light. The brim is long but can be folded back some as needed.
The slit for the pony tail is subtle. So it will blend in when not in use. But to use it, is a little awkward as you will have to feed the pony tail through a narrow slit. Not bad though. Doable.

I do appreciate that there are size offerings for larger heads. It is rare- extremely- that I find a womens hat that fits anything above 22.5". MY cranium is 23.75", so I can't wear most stuff. SO unless you have a bigger head like mine, you will most likely be wanting a medium. If your "large" is too big, then you ordered the wrong size as the size large is accurate (23.03"- 24.0"). It will just fit if your head it 24". Might be snug. It fits mine just right at 23.75". Or if your medium is too small.. then again, likely wrong size. selected. Either way, make sure you got what you ordered.

I use sun hats (when I can find them in my size) a lot. I prefer to avoid the sun. I keep it off my face and body, especially during the summer months. Between sun sensitive meds, rosacea, and just wanting added protection from UV rays, a sun hat is a great thing to have. Since I can add this to my list of companies that sell larger sized hats I will possibly be back to purchase more. I like the overall look (even if I did get something different than anticipated).
text_fidelity_b: Jeff & Aimy Women's Lightweight Cotton Bucket Beach Sun Hats Ponytail Hole Wide Brim UV Protection Foldable Travel Fishing Sunhats Gray

TISUR Titanium Key Rings for Keychains, Quick Release Side Pushing Key Organizer Kit, Wisely Group Your Keys I like the way these rings work - you don't have to use fingernails or overcome a lot of tension to open the ring, and using them doesn't scratch them up or wear off the finish and create shiny spots. They seem resistant to being bent out of shape too...and all while being pleasantly lightweight. They're just...Keyring 2.0. A far superior alternative to the keyring model we've been struggling with for decades now.

Update: Yes, being titanium, they are indeed resistant to being bent out of shape. We have a little devil dog who likes to destroy things; I think it gives him a sense of agency. :) And one of the things he discovered he likes to do is pull the tags off his and his sister-dog's collars. The thin wire rings we originally used to attach the tags to collars made this easy for our destroyer-dog - he just pulled, and the wire rings would bend to allow him to pull the tags right off. I replaced those wire rings with TISUR titanium ones; they're nice and lightweight for the doggles' comfort, and our mechanically-inclined beast hasn't managed to pull a tag off either collar since.

I never thought there could be so much to say about something so simple as a keyring, but these really are next-level - an evolutionary stage beyond the classic keyring we've all used since I was a kid. Highly recommended for strength, light weight, and ease-of-use, all of which surpass the old design by a long shot.

text_fidelity_a: PUNT SURF Non Slip Traction Mat & Surfboard Traction Pad - Versatile Mats for Paddle Board, Kayak, Surfboard, Skimboard, SUP - Premium & Strong 3M Adhesive Put it on the seat portion of a Dave Scadden Outlaw Escape float tube that has an inflatable SUP style seat (dropstitch). Wasn't too sure if it would stick well as the surface is not entirely smooth, it has some dimples on the surface due to the Dropstitch nature of an inflatable SUP. Cleaned the area well and cut to shape. Applied from one end to the other to ensure no bubbles along the way, and then used a hard roller to activate the pressure sensitive adhesive. Let it sit for a day and re-rolled to be sure everything was set well. Used it a week later and it held up perfectly, no peeling, bubbles etc. Even with multiple inflate/deflates of the seat, and sitting on it for 6hrs in the water in 110f temps. The product is really well made, hope I never need to use the warranty or service from them, but it seems if I need it, its there and they are eager to help. Great product!

text_fidelity_a:
Gempestoer Mini Personal Water Filter for Hiking Outdoor Mountaineering, Backpacking, Hunting, Field Military Training, Camping, Travel, and Emergency Preparedness (Green) Has anyone tried this? The main filtering aspect seems good, which to me is the most important. But if you are buying this because of the extras, be careful. Here are the details:
--WHISTLE: it works, on or off the filter tube. It twists on/off. Be sure to keep track of it. LOUD.
--COMPASS: Mine doesn't work. It won't adjust to correct direction, or any direction. It doesn't move, period. I had it side by side with one of my other compasses, and it did nothing. Bummer.
--MIRROR: The flip side of the compass has a mirror, for signaling etc. Twist off compass end to access. Very clear, looks good. Slightly smaller than size of a quarter.
--D-ring clip: mediocre, might want something else. It is attached via a basic "key ring", which is then attached through the molded plastic piece on the tube.
--STRAW: this includes a piece of rubber tubing for attaching to filter and using as a straw- either in a bottle, or to add length for being able to access a water source. Will need to figure out way to carry this separately (dont lose it!). Basic tubing size, so should be easy to replace or buy longer tubing.
--FILTER: all points to it working!
OK, back to the filter. I used it on tap water. I suppose I could have wandered out to my creek and grabbed some water. Maybe I will still do that. While our tap water tastes fine, it is noticeably different compared to our on board fridge water filter. I tried this is a mason jar with tap water. I followed directions (blow first to exhaust, then gently draw up water). I could tell how silky smooth the water tasted with no other tastes coming through. I then took a sip of the tap water without the filter straw and could note the "flavor". So this straw is filtering something for sure.

I have lifestraws, and now this. I am a big fan of redundancy and variety, and the saying "two is one and one is none". I keep straws in my "bug out bag", and truck "get home bag". I have even kept on in my purse. Must have for hiking bag. Having viable water source is #1 for me. These things aren't too expensive, so I find it an easy, budget friendly addition to emergency preparedness. The price is spot on for a single straw. Wish the compass worked.
text_fidelity_b: Gempestoer Mini Personal Water Filter for Hiking Outdoor Mountaineering, Backpacking, Hunting, Field Military Training, Camping, Travel, and Emergency Preparedness (Green)

LifeStraw Mission High-Volume Gravity-Fed Water Purifier, 12 L (LSM12) I received a sample for review, but opinions are my own:

I recommend using this when you get it, even if you are just keeping it for camping or emergencies. They've printed a paragraph on the side of the filter that warns you to go read all the instructions. I really wish they had used that space for something like telling you which part the clean water comes out, and which is the dirty. These things are important, and in the situations where you are likely to use this, reading the instructions may not be possible, so get to know it when you buy it. I've just added some Sharpie notes on the side of mine so I don't end up drinking a cup of concentrated filth.

I didn't have any mud puddles handy, so I just tested it with tap water and a total dissolved solids meter. The water did indeed come out notably cleaner than it went in. Remember to check the inside of the bag before you fill it, and don't just dump water in there like I did, or you'll have soggy accessories.

This is a much easier way to filter a bunch of water than the old filters that needed to be pumped by hand. I'm happy to have it in my disaster kit.
text_fidelity_b: LifeStraw Mission High-Volume Gravity-Fed Water Purifier, 12 L (LSM12)

I wish that NordicTrack offered other seats that one could purchase for this bike.  It was really a disappointment in that respect. I am hoping that the company will fix this terrible seat, and put the same one on that I had on my original bike! Kodiak Canvas Flex-Bow Canvas Tent Deluxe LOVE LOVE LOVE this tent!!!
We have previously owned the classic cheaper coleman tents and when ours wore out, we bought a new coleman... upon opening it, it had tears in the seams...I boxed it up and sent it back. We were so upset by the lack of craftsmanship we decided to research better quality canvas tents. We are a young family and liked the idea of a tent that we could use for years to come. We decided on the 10x14, it's very spacious and we are able to set up a queen, and twin air mattress with plenty of room to store our bags/totes and a large dog/bed. I am a petite lady and I was able to put this tent up by myself (only took 25 min from box to erect, while stopping to look at the directions) it is a very heavy tent, but I was able to put it up with a bit of effort.

The floor is a thick rubber-like material that you can tell isn't gonna leak (and it didn't, even when there were puddles of rain water between the tarp below and tent) I sprayed the tent down (as per directions) prior to our first camping trip. And off we went...
This tent has turned heads every time we camp, it is a heavy duty, quality tent that we know will last for years to come... It is so simple to put up, and we are so pleased with our investment.
We have not yet had it stand the test of a storm, but I have no doubt it will hold up well.
As far as staying warm, the larger tent makes it difficult to stay warm, so bundle up and use warm blankets ;)

Oh, did I mention the tent storage bag?!?! It's awesome, and your tent will always fit, no need for super tight refilling to make it fit in the bag, this bag adjusts and will always fit your rolled up tent (we fold in half, then half again, roll and adjust the bag to fit )

To summarize:
Pros:
Large roomy tent that you can stand and walk around in, the walls are straight so you don't lose storage room
Durable canvas that is waterproof
Quality thick floor that will not leak
Heavy duty metal rods/poles and steaks
Large doors and windows makes the tent feel even more open and allows a cross breeze
The ingenious tent bag that will always be able to fit the tent once rolled up

Cons:
The long poles (when storing) and the weight of the tent

Overall If you are in the market for a quality tent that will last for years to come...buy this tent!

text_fidelity_a:
MARK LAUREN Bodyweight Workout DVD Mobility Rx DVD Set I have owned this 2-DVD set for several weeks now, and I am still on the fence about it. I researched it thoroughly before I purchased it, and the overall reviews seemed very positive. I am a daily exerciser and also a yoga instructor, but as I get older (I'm 49 now), I definitely have increasing aches and pains, and I know there are times when my lack of flexibility limits my yoga practice. I was hoping that Mark Lauren's Mobility Rx set would benefit me in these areas.

I will first provide a brief overview of the workouts, then detail what I liked/didn't like. Both DVDs have a Main Menu which includes selection for Introduction (Lauren's 2-minute explanation of these workouts, which you can find on YouTube), Warm Up (the same for both workouts, and Workout (1 or 2). There is also an option for Music on/off and Closed Captioning on/off.

The Warm-up is what Lauren calls a "movement prep," and it clocks in at 9:39 minutes. In has nice, full-body joint mobility work such as windshield wiper knees, hydrant hip rotations, trunk rotations, one leg bridges, lunges with torso twist, squat, and lunges with lateral reach. Workout #1 is 34 minutes total, including a 4 1/2 minute description of each of the four exercises. (Note that it is NOT easy to skip this. You can select the workout from the Main Menu without doing the Warm-up, but it is also NOT easy to return to the Main Menu AFTER doing the Warm-up for some reason.) There are three rounds in this workout, and they clock in at 8:53, 9:22, and 11:12. The exercises are side-lying snow angel, isometric lunge, zombie squat, and scorpion complex, and they get progressively more challenging with each round. Workout #2 has the same structure but with different exercises. This workout is shorter, with 3 1/2 minute introduction and three rounds of 7:24, 7:37, and 8:14 to clock at 27 minutes total. The exercises are seated roll, straddle reach, spider crawl, and gate swing complex. All of the exercises are well-described in other reviews for those wanting more details.

What I like about Mobility Rx is much shorter than what I don't like, so I will start with that.

WHAT I LIKED ABOUT THESE WORKOUTS:
*The exercises themselves. For the most part, these felt like functional fitness movements that definitely have the potential to benefit my body.
*The Warm-up. Although almost 10 minutes is long for a warm-up, this would make a nice little stand-alone stretch routine; it could also work as a cool-down after other activity.

Okay, that's about all I can think of, so on to what I didn't like.

WHAT I DIDN'T LIKE ABOUT THESE WORKOUTS:
*The fact that they are on 2 separate DVDs. This may seem minor, but there's only a little over an hour of content, so making this set 2 separate DVDs not only feels wasteful to me but also feels like a marketing gimmick, as if they are trying to deceive customers.
*The very poor production values. Honestly, I often don't even notice these types of things on workout DVDs (and I have literally tried 100s), but there were MULTIPLE issues here, including the following: 1) the music - it was just bad, loud and on a repetitive loop (although at least there was a music off option), 2) the sound - it was out of sync with the screen, which is VERY annoying if you are actually looking at Lauren while doing the workout, 3) the menus - as mentioned above, options such as skipping forward and returning to the Main Menu did not work correctly, and 4) the set - also just awful, with a frame around the screen that appears as if you are looking into a 1980s computer and empty fake wood boxes stacked in the corner for no reason
*Lauren's instruction. Other than telling viewers to stand or sit with "tall PRETTY posture"--an awful expression that he uses over and over--he provides little instruction on form and absolutely no modifications. The initial preview of the exercises for each workout offers an anatomical view of the muscles being worked, but Lauren never refers back to this during the workouts themselves, never connecting the movements with the actual benefits for the body.
*The disparity between the two workouts. As you can see by my description above, the first workout is significant longer than the second, but it is also MUCH harder. The second exercise, the isometric lunge, is actually a lunge with the shin placed vertical against a wall/other structure. I would consider this an advanced movement--I have done it in yoga classes only after significantly more prep work than Lauren provides here. Similarly, the fourth exercise, scorpion complex, also incorporate yoga-type movements (plank and downward facing dog), and it requires a good deal of stamina and endurance.

In summary, I believe that these routines are appropriate ONLY FOR EXPERIENCED EXERCISERS. Although I definitely fall into that category myself, and I do see some utility to the movements Lauren offers here, the downsides of this set are a significant detraction for me, and I have not yet decided whether or not I will keep it.
text_fidelity_b: MARK LAUREN Bodyweight Workout DVD Mobility Rx DVD Set

Marinex Glass Custard Cup, 8-1/2-Ounce This 8-1/2 ounce MARINEX GLASS CUSTARD CUP is slightly larger than the small Pyrex custard cups that I've always used for baked custard. However, it's still a very convenient size for single servings of custard, pudding, or ice cream.

The Marinex brand is expensive, but superior to the present-day Pyrex brand, because Marinex glass cookware is made from borosilicate glass. Borosilicate glass, which has a slight green tinge, is less susceptible to thermal shock than the tempered soda lime glass used by Pyrex. (Years ago, Pyrex dishes were also made of borosilicate glass.) I feel safer using glass cookware made with borosilicate glass, because some of my newer Pyrex dishes have shattered when they were removed from the oven and placed on a room-temperature, ceramic-tile countertop. (Now I always place glass cookware on a hotpad or oven mitt.)

When I ordered this item, I thought that the listing must be for four Marinex custard cups, because of the price (about $16). In fact, I received just one custard cup, as the listing promises. The single custard cup is a genuine Marinex custard cup, and it is identical to the ones in the four-cup set that I purchased from Amazon for about the same price (see [[ASIN:B008H07AQC Marinex Set of Four Glass Custard Cups, 8-1/2-Ounce]]). Because this is a 5-star product with a 1-star price, I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

text_fidelity_a: Epiphany Outdoor Gear Pocket Bellows - Weatherproof Collapsible Fire Bellowing Tool for Starting Fire- an Essential Camping Gear After years of blowing at camp fires through pursed lips and getting a face and eyes and lungs full of smoke, I saw a product demonstrated on a Bush Craft video.  It was only available in Europe...  Then I found this on Amazon.  It is stainless steel so it is not light weight for its (small) size.  Its value is in its function and in its collapsiblity.  From a collapsed state of just under 4 inches, it extends to 19 inches,  The larger (.5 inches, diameter) end is placed in the mouth and the narrow end concentrates  oxygenated air from your lungs to a focused stream at the narrow end. Once an initial spark or flame has begun to produce an ember, combustion can be sped up by directing more air precisely at the ember.  That sure beats watching helplessly while the initial spark fails to catch and fades to nothing.  On a dry day with dry, finely processed wood, this might not be needed...but on a cold, damp day with wood that is a bit damp, this makes all the difference between fire and failure.  At first, this device will be stiff to open and close but a little lubricant will help.  Opened up, the rod is sturdy and should last for a good many fires.
text_fidelity_b: Epiphany Outdoor Gear Pocket Bellows - Weatherproof Collapsible Fire Bellowing Tool for Starting Fire- an Essential Camping Gear

This is one of the best, and the price point is great too! It holds 3 litres, which sounds like a lot, but until you've hiked 15 miles in Pennsylvania July heat, you don't realise how much water you need. Having 3 litres of dedicated water to drink is a must, you'll still carry additional water for cooking, but this will get you through the hottest trail days.

The bag fits nicely into your bladder pocket in your day, overnight, or hydration pack. The hose is heavy, and easily fits to where it needs to go. The mouthpiece is tremendous. It can fold down to lessen dripping, and a gentle bite on the tip brings luscious water into your mouth. One of the better mouth pieces I"ve used.

My only complaint is that the top retaining holes are just that..holes. The way my packs and such hold bladders is with a velcro strap, and they don't work 100% with the holes at the top of the bag. It works, but could be better. I found myslef jamming my 2 inch wide strap into one of the holes. I wish it had diffeent options for holding onto the bag. Otherwise, I would have given it 5 stars
text_fidelity_b: Polar Bottle Cenote Hydration System Water Storage Bladder for Backpacks and Hydration Sleeves

text_fidelity_a:
EvoShield PX3 NOCSAE Soccer Shin Guard Not sure how these worked so well for everyone, happy for others, but a word of caution. Any other shin guard you can sort of try on in the store or whatever. This one, if they end up not working for you, say goodbye to your $$. You will not know what they are like until you open them, and then you own them.

Test case, U15BP player. We ordered based on sizing on the EvoShield website. Turns out the size chart on the package is different from that on their web site. We ordered too large based on this discrepancy. Sent those back on our dime and ordered a size smaller-- again shipping on our dime, so already out $10-12. My son now on the top end of the size range, meaning the product ought to be approaching too small. Molding went just fine. But final product is simply too big, we knew this the minute they came out of the sleeve but by then we owned them. These shin guards are huge, top to bottom, side to side, and too thick. Watched him trying to play soccer and these shields are damaging his traps and touch, the ball contacts these guards low on his legs and the edges are so thick, there is surface all around his leg that "catches" the ball while maneuvering, resulting in all manner of unfortunate ball contact.

Have calipers here... thickness is 7/16" ! And everyone claiming these are lightweight must not have bought shin guards since 1975. These easily weigh twice our cheap Nike guards. Will they protect you? Must say they will, but then so would a full leg cast and it might have better touch.

Other manufacturers going to ever lower profile guards, these going the other way... now we own a pair of $50 doorstops, maybe we can donate them. No returns on opened product (these are in foiled sealed packages). Is that a worthwhile risk for reinventing something that did not really need reinventing ?

Will give two stars simply because the product appears to be more or less what they look like, just no way to have ascertained the size of the final product.
text_fidelity_b: EvoShield PX3 NOCSAE Soccer Shin Guard

text_fidelity_a: Rough Rider Folder Denim Micarta RR2181 I have a soft spot for traditional folding knives.  And Wharncliffes.. This is both.  It's also a good quality, super sharp, stainless slipjoint folder with a half stop and a Micarta handle.  For 20 bucks (or at least that's around what I paid for it).  This knife is at  a sweet spot in terms of size.  Any larger and it would start to need a clip and sort of cease to be "pocket friendly".  I mean what else can I say.. I was skeptical of the Rough Rider brand but they really are well made for the money.  I also bought a peanut for my wife and it, too is built to a high standard.  For some folks, half stops are a must.  I generally find them irritating and that may be my only gripe with this blade.  The nail nicks are too sharp to put half stops in this blade.  The blade starts to shift into the half stop and the nick twists and sometimes breaks the edge of my thumbnail.  I thought I was imagining this so i tried it with my pointer finger and sure enough, after pulling the blade a few times, the edge of my fingernail would break.  I may file or polish the edge of the nick a bit and that would solve the issue.  The blade sticks out enough that I can just grab it most of the time without the nail nick.  A slight thumb cutout on one scale would improve this .  Oh, and I could do without it being stainless.  I greatly prefer sharpening carbon steel, but that's just personal preference. Overall this knife will be a great work knife and would delight any wood worker.
text_fidelity_b: Rough Rider Folder Denim Micarta RR2181

Digital Counting Jump Rope,9.9 ft Adjustable Speed Skipping Rope with Calorie Counter ,Workout Gear for Fitness,Exercises,Boxing,Weighted Cordless Jump Ropes for Adult Men Women Kids A simple addition to anyone’s exercise routine is jumping rope. Any rope will do in a pinch, but it’s much better when you have a fancy rope made for the purpose and a rope that easily goes the extra mile is this Smart Jump Rope.

What do you get with this jump rope? You get a rope that has electronic controls that tell you how many turns you make, how many minutes you jump, and the total calories burned. To make the setup complete, you program your weight in kilograms. You’re then ready to start jumping and improve your fitness.

One of the interesting options with this jump rope is that you can perform the action without using the actual rope. This cordless option might sound unusual at first, but the idea is to jump off the ground with each turn of your wrists. You are still getting the same fitness as with a rope, without the annoyance of not clearing the rope with your feet and possibly getting tangled or tripping.

Once you finish using this digital jumping rope just pack it up in the included storage bag until your next scheduled exercise time. If you’re a fitness freak who likes precise, scientific measurements, your next exercise time will likely be sooner than you think. I can’t speak for everyone, but I like anything that shows my statistics, and I am motivated to exercise more when I can see the facts like number of turns, total minutes, and calories burned.

We could all use a little more exercise in our daily routine. This digital jump rope is an excellent way to better fitness and it’s the only jump rope I have ever used with digital readouts. Get one for yourself and improve your health.
text_fidelity_b: Digital Counting Jump Rope,9.9 ft Adjustable Speed Skipping Rope with Calorie Counter ,Workout Gear for Fitness,Exercises,Boxing,Weighted Cordless Jump Ropes for Adult Men Women Kids

text_fidelity_a:
ChicoBag Travel Pack rePETe Compact Recycled Backpack UPDATE! I used this bag almost daily for a 2 week trip that included lots of beaching and city walking. It was very handy and easily held all that I needed for the day (food, beach towel, book, water, clothing, etc.). You can't carry a TON of heavy stuff in this bag - the seam ripped a little bit - but the fabric itself seems sturdy. An internal zip pocket would have been very handy, I'd LOVE it if the bag was waterproof, and I was disappointed that the seam ripped. But overall still a great bag to travel with.

BUT! ChicoBag is an AMAZING company. The bag comes with a ONE YEAR WARRANTY. So, if your seam rips, the bag tears, etc. contact ChicoBag. They might just replace/repair your bag. They are sending me a free replacement nearly a year after I bought mine. Well done!

So far so good! I've only used the bag once so far but it's great. It's comfortable to wear and holds a lot. The side pockets are large and have elastic at the top so things don't fall out. My only wish is for a small internal zip pocket - having this pocket on the outside is good for small items, but I'd prefer to keep my wallet / phone in an internal zip pocket. (My second wish would be for some kind of hook/daisy chain on the bag so that you could easily attach things. But that might take away from the design and light weight of the bag.)
The bag is very easy to zip back up into the zippered pocket.
The black pattern is nice - it's a bit shiny but very subtle. I'd dare say it's a tad stylish!
Very impressed with the hydration pouch - it looks like it could easily accommodate my 1.5L Camelback hydration bladder.
The straps have a tiny bit of padding, and the sternum strap works well - it's also adjustable and removable. There is also a hook for a waist strap.
text_fidelity_b: ChicoBag Travel Pack rePETe Compact Recycled Backpack

text_fidelity_a:
adidas Men's Team Issue Fold Beanie A winner if there ever was one… This is totally iconic Adidas, in providing a complete classic style- we all know and love!! This doesn’t try to add some unique twist nor, want to reinvent the wheel.. This is just a sleek, straightforward, 100% purely classic style beanie! Something so many people have come to expect and appreciate!!

Material used is soft and does not create the dreaded “hat head” itch when worn- and I'm talking, even when worn all day! My 17yr old opts to wear a beanie in leui of when most would adorn the baseball hat- Yes! 24/7 -365 days of the year! (365 even includes summer!! Which btw, drives his dad crazy!!) I’d like to say it’s a hip trendy phase- but, we’re coming up on 3+ years of this now- and still going strong! And mind you.. My son is the type to complain about a pea under his mattress…(you know that type…the youngest with a golden child attitude?!) **IF this made him too hot, itchy, uncomfortable or, not stylish.. it would be a no go and yet, he religiously wears this. That is the best endorsement if there ever was one!!

So, this may make you wonder- can this breathable hat actually keep you warm? Yes sir!! Made from acrylic, this will help keep anyone’s head retaining heat, and warm- even in the cold Utah winters! Keep in mind: This isn’t made with heavy wool or, with a fleece liner.. So, it’s not best for sub zero extreme temps/water proof needing situations.. that would be winter gear!!
One can expect a day to day option with great style and solid, adequate warmth from this beanie! But, the everyday wear ability is different from winter Snow gear!

This is a perfect blend of elastin which is used to maintain the shape of the beanie itself.. And to help keep the hat on top of the head! Surprisingly, this has ample stretch and can fit the largest of heads- Yet take note, this isn’t the slouchy style trend.. NO!! This is the classic “night watch cap” by definition -Best part of all, it is a beanie that can mold to the head and as we all know, not all head shapes are created equal- but, with this hats ability to shape shift.. it really can be a “one-size-fits-all!“ And then, with a run thru the machine wash/dry cycle as needed.. it can fall back into shape- like magic! (Note: as with any beanie.. avoid heat drying if, concern for shrinking. I tend to avoid this at first and use dryer when beanie becomes worn in and seems to become too loose- boom! Doing this, Beanie will be back in action..!!) **Also, with the folded edge this is adjustable! One can adjust hat size by less/more of the fold- A total bonus in getting the right fit!

As you can see I’m a total fan and true believer Adidas makes the best beanie by far 100%- at a slightly higher price point it is worth it.. As, this will last you seasons to come! With a child who wears a beanie as often as he wears underwear, I’ve tried every version on the market and hands-down this is our “go to” every time! I hope this info helps your decision… Feel free to let me know!
text_fidelity_b: adidas Men's Team Issue Fold Beanie

Fuliuyu Long Range Green Presentation Pointer High Power Flashlight with USB Cable, Rechargeable Adjustable Focus for Night Astronomy Outdoor Work Pet Interaction Conference While not an indictment of the quality of the product, this laser is listed as being good for interacting with pets. However, this laser is powerful enough to do some serious eye damage! It's powerful enough to pop a dark colored balloon if held in place for a moment. In fact, it's powerful enough that if I point it at the back of my hand and hold it in place for a few seconds, it begins to sting! That's more than bright enough to permanently damage your pet's eyes, especially if you're pointing it towards them in order to get them to chase after it. Lasers like these are not currently well regulated on this site, so you should not assume that they are safe. I'd advise wearing proper laser safety goggles when using this laser, never point it towards a person, and please don't use it to play with your pets!

And now that I've got that diatribe out of the way, the product itself seems fairly well made, and at a decent price. It has a nice protector ring that covers the "on" button to help prevent accidental discharge. This helps with safety, as well as keeping your battery from draining due to accidental use. The beam is pretty well focused, and I don't see much diffusion even 50-100 feet out. On a cloudy day, the laser point (not the beam, but the spot where it is pointed) is clearly visible at 100-200 feet of distance. At night, the beam itself is clearly visible in the atmosphere.
text_fidelity_b: Fuliuyu Long Range Green Presentation Pointer High Power Flashlight with USB Cable, Rechargeable Adjustable Focus for Night Astronomy Outdoor Work Pet Interaction Conference
